title: Answer
description:
Strangers are to be received. Some who did so received God’s messengers without knowing it. This house is still under that duty.

Marriage is honorable and the bed undefiled. A word about the heavenly sanctuary still governs the body.

I will never leave you nor forsake you was first spoken to a leader at the threshold of the land. It is now given to all the saints.

God is helper, so man is not the one to fear, and covetousness is not the refuge.
